bundled.scope: binary and required config only; excludes proprietary web frontend and preseeded database
headless runtime built from this checkout; Node service lifecycle must use the packaged Supervisor entry

separate_or_disabled.policy: Keep the original frozen DSH plugin v0.2.93 distribution channel; do not package the same-version development-generated plugin bundle or a DSH host.
The pinned Herdr v0.9.5 binaries and ConPTY helpers are bundled. Node sessions are currently in-memory and do not claim reattachment after APP/Node exit.
Do not claim office conversion is available in the cross-platform candidate until fixed Windows, Linux and macOS LibreOffice assets and a user-facing repair route are verified.
Do not bundle or expose RustDesk remote control until platform assets, user authorization and revoke flows are complete.
